 Inside Your Health: Medicare open enrollment
 Medicare open enrollment is underway and this year 320,000 Minnesotans have been notified that their Medicare Advantage plans are being discontinued for 2027.
 That means all those people need to reconsider their coverage, with many facing higher costs and fewer choices of doctors and hospitals.
 Our KSTP health expert, Dr. Archelle Georgiou, is here to break down the options, including one important opportunity that many may not know about.
